correctness.rationale: The fourth moment coefficients (3,6,42,324,3348) follow from exact centered Gaussian even moments. The normalized quotient r²N_r(t)/(1+6t²)² and derivative q_r have been algebraically reconstructed. The quartic discriminant is a negative multiple of a degree-six polynomial whose rational Sturm chain has three sign variations at both 0 and positive infinity, so q_r has exactly one positive root. Positive-coefficient monotonicity gives a unique contractivity crossing; rational quadratic positivity at r=1/3 and a strict witness at r=1/2 bracket it. The elimination resultant and Sturm counts isolate the unique degree-ten threshold root. All identities and rational sign counts were independently recomputed from the explicit checker in this package. No numerical finite sample is used to prove a universal claim.

value.rationale: The first and third Hermite eigenmodes form the simplest canonical mean-zero odd subspace containing a nonlinear eigenlevel. The theorem gives its exact operator norm for every damping parameter, a complete and rigid optimizer classification, a uniquely algebraic sharp L2-to-L4 contraction radius, and a strict improvement over the all-input Nelson threshold. The mixed first/third interaction forces immediate nonpure extremizers; this is structural spectral information not supplied by an isolated norm computation. The parameter is natural for sharp restricted semigroup smoothing, rather than an arbitrary numerical sample.
